guide.title: Guide & Documentation
guide.desc: Learn about the core mechanics and usage.
guide.gascii_desc: Gascii is a high-performance terminal-based media extraction and processing utility. It converts standard video pipelines into lightweight ASCII matrix displays directly inside your terminal environment.
guide.gascii_f1: Direct YouTube API integration for MP4/MP3 retrieval
guide.gascii_f3: Seamless audio-visual synchronization without UI overhead
guide.mienjine_desc: MiEnjine is a specialized 3D rendering engine built for the terminal and web, designed to render GLB and MMD (PMX/VMD) files with extreme efficiency.
guide.mienjine_f1: Native support for PMX character models and VMD motion files
guide.mienjine_f2: Integrated audio playback synced with camera and stage animations
guide.mienjine_f3: Advanced lighting and physics calculation within a minimal footprint

tour.s2_desc:
termplay is a project that makes terminal-based programs
easily executable via a desktop launcher.
tour.s3_desc:
Here is the list of programs
currently available for download.
tour.s4_desc:
Gascii is a program that plays videos inside the terminal,
supporting grayscale or RGB display modes.
tour.s5_desc:
Mienjine is a 3D rendering engine for the terminal,
suitable for playing MMD (PMX/VMD) files directly in your CLI.
tour.s6_desc:
Now, let me show you how to
download videos and use the launcher.
tour.s7_desc:
Here you can download videos,
access files, or configure launcher details.
tour.s8_desc: Let's start by clicking the Launcher button.
tour.s9_desc:
The Launcher settings allow you to configure the install path
and toggle hardware acceleration.
tour.s10_desc: Next, let's head over to the Library.
tour.s11_desc:
The Library panel lists all downloaded videos
and audio files saved locally on your machine.
tour.s12_desc: Next, let's check the Asset Manager.
tour.s13_desc:
If you don't have media files, you can download YouTube videos directly!
Experience the convenience of one-click download.
tour.s14_desc: Now, let's examine the Play button.
tour.s15_desc:
This details menu allows you to run integrity checks,
open the local installation directory, or uninstall files.
tour.s16_desc: Finally, let's take a look at this floating toolbar.
tour.s17_desc:
You can find our GitHub link here.
Giving us a GitHub Star would be highly appreciated!
tour.s18_desc:
That concludes the interactive tour!
Have a great time!
